from datetime import datetime, timedelta

today = datetime.now().date()
cutoff = today - timedelta(days=6)
print("Today:", today, "Cutoff:", cutoff)

total = 0.0

        total += req["amount"]
        print(req["payment_request_id"], req["amount"], created)

print("Total:", total)
